title: End-of-Support for Cloud Connector Repository Certificate

blocks.text: The TLS certificate for the Zscaler Cloud Connector software update repository will expire on March 18, 2027. To preserve software update functionality and avoid deployment failures, customers must update their virtual machines or use the latest marketplace images. Zscaler recommends that all customers complete these updates by December 31, 2026:

blocks.item: Existing Cloud Connector Deployments: No action is required. Zscaler is deploying an automatic update to patch the CA trust bundle. No restart is required.
New Cloud Connector Deployments: The updated marketplace image is required when deploying new Cloud Connectors after March 18, 2027.

blocks.text: You are impacted if you are running Cloud Connector or Branch Connector virtual machines with versions lower than 1.146. These versions lack the DigiCert G2 certificate chain required to validate the newly updated software packages published to the package repo after March 18, 2027. Zscaler published an automatic software patch in March 2026 that recognizes the new DigiCert G2 certificate chain. It is included in the following software versions:
If you do not take action before March 18, 2027:

blocks.item: Existing Cloud Connector Deployments: If the automatic fix is not applied, existing Cloud Connectors lose the ability to receive future software updates, including critical security patches and bug fixes.
New Cloud Connector Deployments: Deployments using older marketplace images after March 18, 2027 are unable to connect to the update repository and come online.

Autoscaling Group (ASG) and/or Custom Deployment Templates: ASGs using old launch templates, warm pool (Amazon Web Services (AWS)), or instance templates (Microsoft Azure/Google Cloud Platform (GCP)) spin up new instances that cannot connect to the update repository, resulting in scale out failures.

blocks.text: To determine whether you are impacted, check your Cloud Connector software version:

blocks.item: In the Zscaler Admin Console, from the navigation menu, go to Zero Trust Cloud > Cloud Connector > Cloud Connector Groups.
The Cloud Connector Groups page appears.
On the Cloud Connector Groups page, expand a Cloud Connector group and click the Edit icon.
The Edit Cloud Connector window appears.
In the Edit Cloud Connector window, click the Upgrade Status tab.
On the Upgrade Status tab, in the Upgrade Information section, locate the Current Version.

blocks.text: To learn more, see Understanding Cloud Connector Repository Certificate Expiry and Renewal.
